full_judgment: The petitioner while working as a Journalist in the then Pakistan Observer (now Bangladesh Observer) was selected by the Central Public Service Commission of Pakistan to the post of Assistant Director in the Department of Tourism, Government of Pakistan and he joined in the post on 7.12.63 at the age of 29 years 9 months 1 day his date of birth being 6.3.1939. The Department of Tourism was abolished in 1970 whereupon he was appointed as a Deputy Manager in the Pakistan Tourism Development Corporation which took over the functions of the Department of Tourism and the petitioner joined his new post on 1.1.1971. After liberation of Bangladesh, the erstwhile Pakistan Tourism Development was replaced by the Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation, a statutory Corporation established under the President Order No. 143 of 1972 and the service of the petitioner was vested in the Corporation under the said order. The petitioner was promoted to the post of Manager in the Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation with effect from 8.12.1973. Thereafter the petitioner was sent to Australia in 1973 for higher training in tourism and then in 1976 he was sent for higher training in Japan and successfully completed both courses. While serving as Manager in Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation the petitioner was appointed a Director on contract basis in the Directorate of Relief and Rehabilitation under the same Ministry under orders of the President with lien in Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation and he joined his new post on 6.9.1983. A photostat of the said appointment is annexed as Annexure 'A'. The contract which was initially for a period of 3 years was extended for a further period of 2 years with effect from 6.9.1986 under the same terms and conditions keeping his lien in the Corporation. The petitioner was returned to Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation on expiry of his extended period of contract to re-join his original post vide Ministry of Establishment notification No. SA MA/UNI-4-157/83-555 dated 6.9.88. A photostat of the said notification is marked Annexure 'B'.
